title: desmodium scorpiurus
intro: Desmodium scorpiurus, commonly known as Stick-tight or Catchweed, is a perennial herb belonging to the legume family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The plant is known to possess therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body. Bioactive constituents present in Desmodium scorpiurus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal efficacy.
